messages:
alex: quick question — does anyone have a short promql/grafana panel that correlates SM% (sm utilization) with KV cache eviction rate, split by batch_size? trying to prove the batch-size tradeoff for a customer POC

maya: i built something similar for EU region last quarter, but i filtered by pool. can you share the pool/region?

alex: thanks — region = us-west-2, pool = provisioned-gpu-ff. want a single panel that can toggle region/pool ideally.

sam: fwiw evictions spike when batch_size > 8 on that pool. i usually look at two series: kernel_sm_active_pct and kvcache_evictions_total rate. can do a combined panel with overlay.

jin: i pasted a quick promql that worked for me, use rate() for evictions and avg_over_time for sm pct. might be noisy but it's a start:

```
# sm pct (avg over 1m)
avg(avg_over_time(gpu_sm_active_total{region="us-west-2",pool="provisioned-gpu-ff"}[1m])) by (instance, batch_size)

# kvcache evictions per second (1m rate)
rate(kvcache_evictions_total{region="us-west-2",pool="provisioned-gpu-ff"}[1m])

# hint: use legend as {{instance}} / {{batch_size}} and apply a transform to divide evictions by tokens/sec if you want normalized rate
```

maya: that looks good. for grafana panel use "Transform: Outer join" on batch_size label so we can plot sm% vs evictions on same X by time.

kat: pinging for a quick review — @alex can you drop the grafana dashboard JSON or a tiny PR? i can review and add a templated region/pool variable.

alex: will open a tiny draft PR with the panel JSON in a minute. putting it under dashboards/gpu/observability so devs can copy.

sam: re: alerting — current kvcache-eviction alert is at 5 evictions/s sustained 5m. for this pool maybe move to 10/s if batch_size > 16. worth adding a separate alert rule with label matcher on batch_size.

jin: agree. also add a note to the alert doc: high evictions + sm% > 80% => likely memory pressure, not just load.

opsbot: deploy-status: dashboard-patch branch deployed to staging — panels available at https://grafana.internal.redwood/dashboard/db/gpu-poc?orgId=1

alex: saw it, thanks opsbot. @kat i'll link PR in ~5m. thanks everyone, this helps the POC a lot :thumbsup:
